info.title: Fretchen AI Assistant (LLM) Service
info.description: AI chat assistant, paid via x402 batch-settlement USDC payment channels.
info.x-guidance: OpenAI chat-completions body. POST / with { model, messages: [{ role, content }, ...] } and no payment header to receive a 402 with x402 batch-settlement payment requirements (accepts[]). Open/top up a payment channel per the requirements, retry with the payment header, and the service returns a standard OpenAI chat.completion object. Streaming (stream: true) is not supported. Each message is metered and settled up to a per-message price ceiling; the real cost is usage-derived and typically lower. Note: payment uses x402 batch-settlement (a stateful channel), so a stock OpenAI SDK cannot pay this endpoint without batch-settlement client wiring — the OpenAI shape is for body legibility, not drop-in SDK use.

x-interop-floor: A compatible llm/v1 agent MUST advertise at least one accepts[] entry with asset USDC on network Base (eip155:8453), scheme batch-settlement. Request/response schema is defined by this document's LLMChatRequest/LLMChatResponse. See README.md.

post.summary: Chat with the AI assistant (x402 batch-settlement USDC payment)
post.description: Sends a prompt to the LLM and returns its response. Payment is settled per message via an x402 batch-settlement USDC payment channel, capped at a per-message price ceiling.

200.description: LLM response generated and payment settled successfully

402.description: Payment required. Body/headers (Payment-Required, X-Payment) carry the x402 batch-settlement payment requirements to satisfy and retry with.

model.description: The model to use. Only the advertised model id(s) are served; others return model_not_found.

useDummyData.description: Vendor extension (not OpenAI): forces a mock completion. Testnet networks always mock regardless.

usage.description: Token usage; the settled charge is derived from it.
